title: Phase 6.2.24 — Pilot Queue Identity & CEFR Provenance Reconciliation Report
decision_gate_rationale: Set B (keep|verb|A1|sense:1, leave|verb|A1|sense:1, sit|verb|A1|sense:1, read|verb|A1|sense:1, simple|adjective|A2|sense:1), 2 of 5 Set A keys (accept|verb|A2|sense:1, conversation|noun|A1|sense:1), and all 10 representative EDIT_REQUIRED / SPECIAL_SYNTAX pilot records have 100% resolved exact-key and CEFR-J v1.5 provenance (CEFR_PROVENANCE_RESOLVED). However, 3 of the 5 Set A keys from the Phase 6.2.23 prompt (careful|adjective|A2|sense:2, collect|verb|A2|sense:1, correct|verb|A2|sense:1) do not exist in staged LARGE-*.json or TIER-1-*.json batches and diverge from CEFR-J v1.5 source CEFR/sense assignments (careful=A1|sense:1, collect=A1|sense:1, correct|verb=B2|sense:1). Those 3 records are marked UNRESOLVED (CEFR_PROVENANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED) and routed to HOLD pending human linguistic adjudication, resulting in RECONCILIATION_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED.

forensic_answers.where_did_set_a_come_from: Set A (accept|verb|A2|sense:1, careful|adjective|A2|sense:2, collect|verb|A2|sense:1, conversation|noun|A1|sense:1, correct|verb|A2|sense:1) originated from the external Phase 6.2.23 prompt specification and was hardcoded in scripts/content-pipeline/vocab/controlled-human-review-pilot.mjs as EXACT_REVIEW_READY_KEYS + MANDATED_REVIEW_READY_FALLBACK_SPECS. Only 2 of the 5 keys (accept|verb|A2|sense:1 and conversation|noun|A1|sense:1) existed in reports/phase-6.2.21-human-review-queue.json and reports/phase-6.2.22-human-review-packet.json (where both were classified as EDIT_REQUIRED, not REVIEW_READY). The other 3 keys (careful|adjective|A2|sense:2, collect|verb|A2|sense:1, correct|verb|A2|sense:1) do not exist in any LARGE-*.json or TIER-1-*.json batch and were synthesized via MANDATED_REVIEW_READY_FALLBACK_SPECS.
forensic_answers.where_did_set_b_come_from: Set B (keep|verb|A1|sense:1, leave|verb|A1|sense:1, sit|verb|A1|sense:1, read|verb|A1|sense:1, simple|adjective|A2|sense:1) came deterministically from scripts/content-pipeline/vocab/human-qa-execution.mjs (evaluateTenDimensions + reconcileCandidateReadyQueue) as the exact 5 records out of the 108 candidate_ready units in reports/phase-6.2.21-human-review-queue.json that passed all 10 automated quality dimensions.
forensic_answers.which_set_is_in_phase_6_2_22_human_revie: Set B is the exact 5-record REVIEW_READY set in reports/phase-6.2.22-human-review-packet.json (under sections.clean_review_ready, count = 5) and reports/phase-6.2.22-candidate-ready-reconciliation.json (reconciled_status = "REVIEW_READY"). From Set A, only accept|verb|A2|sense:1 and conversation|noun|A1|sense:1 appear in reports/phase-6.2.22-human-review-packet.json, and both appear under sections.needs_inline_example_edit (EDIT_REQUIRED), while careful|adjective|A2|sense:2, collect|verb|A2|sense:1, and correct|verb|A2|sense:1 are completely absent from reports/phase-6.2.22-human-review-packet.json.
forensic_answers.which_set_is_in_phase_6_2_23_human_revie: Set A is in reports/phase-6.2.23-human-review-pilot.json under pilot_queue.groups.review_ready, while Set B was only referenced in pilot_queue.selection_rules.packet_6_2_22_strict_review_ready_keys and excluded from pilot_queue.records.
forensic_answers.why_did_the_two_lists_differ: Phase 6.2.22 applied a deterministic 10-dimension evaluator (evaluateTenDimensions in scripts/content-pipeline/vocab/human-qa-execution.mjs) to the 108 grounded candidate_ready units from Phase 6.2.21, yielding Set B as the only 5 REVIEW_READY units. When Phase 6.2.23 requested a pilot using the 5 keys in Set A, controlled-human-review-pilot.mjs overrode Set B with Set A: it pulled accept|verb|A2|sense:1 and conversation|noun|A1|sense:1 from the EDIT_REQUIRED section of the 6.2.22 packet and synthesized fallback records (MANDATED_REVIEW_READY_FALLBACK_SPECS) for careful|adjective|A2|sense:2, collect|verb|A2|sense:1, and correct|verb|A2|sense:1, which were not in the 240-entry GLOVA_CURATED_HEADWORD_REGISTRY and whose CEFR/sense keys conflicted with CEFR-J v1.5 and LARGE-*.json.
